entries.speaker: Mementos Navigation
entries.en: You can quick travel within Mementos. Open [n]the map with [clr 2][f 1 10 53][clr 27], select [clr 2]Mementos Overview[clr 27],[n]and choose where you want to go.

entries.speaker: Mementos Navigation
entries.en: This can only be done in [clr 2]certain locations[clr 27],[n]such as the [clr 2]Mementos entrance[clr 27] and the [clr 2]train[n]platforms at the end of each area[clr 27].
